text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is delighted when her Trainer 
describes her running as "thrilling, like 
something amazing is about to begin."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because it feels just like watching her 
grandmother's magic. In other words, she 
is able to cast her racing magic upon her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running in a special race like the Oka Sho 
might just enhance her racing magic and 
make it complete. With high hopes in her 
heart, she headed toward the paddock.
